Connolly is the filer of H.810, a bill to extend voting rights in municipal elections to noncitizen residents. Page text: 'By Representative Connolly of Cambridge, a petition (accompanied by bill, House, No. 810) of Mike Connolly relative to extending voting rights in municipal elections to noncitizen voters.'

findings.passage: That proposal was opposed by the Speaker and did not pass, but I have continued co-sponsoring Same-Day Registration bills because voting should be made more accessible — not more difficult.
findings.note: Campaign site statement on voting access, about same-day registration. It does not name ID or citizenship documents. Saved as related material only.
